title: Film Academy Invites 529 to Become Members Including Jacob Elordi, Teyana Taylor and New Disney CEO Josh D’Amaro
summary: Of 2026’s invitees, 42 percent are women, 56 percent hail from underrepresented communities and 53 percent are based outside of the United States (in 60 different countries and territories).
tags: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
